nodes.label: Money & payment protection layer (HMAC webhook, server-side price/bonus)
nodes.norm_label: money & payment protection layer (hmac webhook, server-side price/bonus)
nodes.rationale: Prices and bonuses are 100% recomputed server-side so the client cannot tamper (8/8 tests); bonus debit is two-phase.

nodes.label: Admin panel review note with client-side demo password
nodes.norm_label: admin panel review note with client-side demo password
nodes.rationale: Suggested giving reviewers a hardcoded client-side admin password; superseded by server-side admin login in later security work.

nodes.label: Switch LoginScreen to OTP auth (requestOtp/verifyOtp)
nodes.rationale: The old name+phone flow issues no real auth token, so the new orders.listRule returns 401 by design; this forces the OTP migration before shipping.

nodes.label: Leaked PocketBase admin password rotation
nodes.rationale: The PocketBase admin password was committed to git history; deleting script files does not remove it, so rotation must happen before any other step.

nodes.label: Migration roll-back plan
nodes.rationale: Every step is reversible (stop Caddy to fall back to HTTP in pb.js, delete hooks, keep old LoginScreen, partial i18n is fine, delete client bonus logic last).

nodes.label: Move admin login server-side (adminLogin)
nodes.rationale: Admin password was compared client-side from settings; moving to PocketBase admin auth keeps it bcrypt-hashed server-side and out of the client bundle (required before App Store submission).

nodes.label: Remaining operator risks register
nodes.rationale: Secrets in git history, plaintext HTTP backend, hooks not deployed, otp_codes collection missing, clients base->auth migration, pre-OTP LoginScreen, client-side admin password, Green API token in localStorage, unvalidated referredBy, no Sentry DSN, no staging, no tests. Note: it cites 'npm run secure-rules' but package.json names the script pb:secure.

nodes.label: Migration Guide: demo to production
nodes.rationale: Ordered, individually reversible steps (est. 4-6h) to move the shop from a demo setup with client-side secrets to a production backend.

nodes.label: AndroidManifest config (cleartext off, bank/WhatsApp package queries, permissions)
nodes.norm_label: androidmanifest config (cleartext off, bank/whatsapp package queries, permissions)
nodes.rationale: Cleartext traffic stays off for Play Store after the HTTPS backend migration.

nodes.label: Release AAB build + upload-key signing
nodes.rationale: Keystore passwords are read from environment variables rather than committed to build.gradle; Play App Signing handles the rest.

nodes.label: iOS Capacitor wrapper (App Store)
nodes.rationale: Native capabilities used: haptics, local push, native audio record/playback for fragrance voice notes, splash, status bar, keyboard, offline cart. States no Android target exists in the repo.

nodes.label: Android Capacitor first-time setup guide
nodes.rationale: The project ships iOS only; Android must be added locally with JDK 17 + Android SDK.

nodes.label: Branded 'Kemal Usman' pure-CSS intro animation
nodes.rationale: Pure CSS because the CSP blocks inline JS; main.jsx removes the node after the outro; matches the white native splash so launch reads as one seamless animation; respects dark mode and reduced motion.

nodes.label: Content Security Policy meta (self + own API, O!Dengi, Green API, Nominatim, Instagram)
nodes.norm_label: content security policy meta (self + own api, o!dengi, green api, nominatim, instagram)
nodes.rationale: style-src allows unsafe-inline because the app uses inline style objects; object-src none and frame-ancestors none.

nodes.label: Client hardening (no secrets in bundle, no XSS sinks, CSP, nosniff, noopener, npm audit 0)
nodes.norm_label: client hardening (no secrets in bundle, no xss sinks, csp, nosniff, noopener, npm audit 0)

nodes.label: Dark luxury style with gold accent (#C9A84C)
nodes.norm_label: dark luxury style with gold accent (#c9a84c)
nodes.rationale: Aims for Apple-level polish and a luxury-fashion feel, premium but accessible, for 18-35 fragrance lovers.

nodes.label: Accessible viewport (user-scalable=no removed)
nodes.rationale: Apple/Play accessibility reviewers flag disabling pinch-zoom.

nodes.label: Monochrome near-black brand system (#111111 accent)
nodes.rationale: A settled brand choice, not an open question.

nodes.label: React + Vite template README
nodes.rationale: Stock Vite template boilerplate (plugin-react/SWC, React Compiler not enabled for dev/build performance); no project-specific content.

nodes.label: CapApp-SPM package README
nodes.rationale: Hosts Swift Package Manager dependencies for the Capacitor project; must not be modified manually.

nodes.label: House description format (top/middle/base notes, longevity, desc + shortDesc)
nodes.norm_label: house description format (top/middle/base notes, longevity, desc + shortdesc)

nodes.label: MEDIUM-confidence entries to verify (A Scent, Amber Empire, Ambre Levant)
nodes.norm_label: medium-confidence entries to verify (a scent, amber empire, ambre levant)
nodes.rationale: Header says 2 entries are MEDIUM but 3 are flagged in the body; verify against fragrantica.ru.

nodes.label: Pilot batch: 25 Russian fragrance descriptions
nodes.rationale: Approval batch covering brands such as Carolina Herrera, Mugler, Dior, Prada, Louis Vuitton, MFK, Xerjoff, Parfums de Marly and Kenzo.

nodes.label: Brand trademark disclaimer for decanted originals
nodes.norm_label: brand trademark disclaimer for decanted originals
nodes.rationale: The service sells decants from original bottles and claims no rights over brand owners' trademarks.

nodes.label: Principle: trust in authenticity
nodes.rationale: Decant buyers are trialing expensive brands, so presentation must read credible and premium, never counterfeit-adjacent.

nodes.label: Hardcoded Cyrillic JSX counter (warn-only)
nodes.rationale: Warn-only while the i18n migration is in progress; intended to become blocking once the count reaches zero.

nodes.label: lint-build-audit CI job
nodes.rationale: Runs lint, a production build against the HTTPS VITE_PB_URL, npm audit and secret scans on every push to main and every pull request.

nodes.label: Committed-secret pattern check step
nodes.rationale: Fails the build if previously leaked secret strings or the open-rules script names reappear in src/, scripts/, deploy/ or pb_hooks/.

nodes.label: Duplicate i18n keys and hardcoded RU strings
nodes.norm_label: duplicate i18n keys and hardcoded ru strings

nodes.label: Legal documents (Privacy Policy, Terms, Data Protection RU)
nodes.norm_label: legal documents (privacy policy, terms, data protection ru)

nodes.label: Six-cell OTP input
nodes.rationale: Premium OTP standard; a hidden input preserves SMS autofill.

nodes.label: SMS OTP authentication (pb_hooks/otp.pb.js)
nodes.rationale: Rate-limited: 5 requests per hour per phone, 5 verify attempts per code, 5-minute TTL; SMS provider pluggable.

nodes.label: pb-secure-rules.js (schema migration + locked API rules)
nodes.rationale: Replaces the dangerous open-rules script; never touches a value without also adding the matching access rule.

nodes.label: adminLogin _superusers endpoint fallback
nodes.rationale: Newer PocketBase renamed admins to _superusers; try the legacy endpoint first, fall back on 404, and accept either data.admin or data.record.

nodes.label: Hero banner image URL + onError fix
nodes.norm_label: hero banner image url + onerror fix
nodes.rationale: Banners loaded from the production DB had no uploaded images, so fileUrl is only used when both collectionId and image exist and broken images are hidden.

nodes.label: Banner image onError gradient guard
nodes.rationale: A broken banner image is replaced with a gradient instead of a broken image (Guideline 2.1(a) bug fix).

nodes.label: Cart persistence (localStorage parfum_cart)
nodes.rationale: Every cart mutation must sync to localStorage so the cart survives page reload.

nodes.label: Modern best-practice decision rule
nodes.rationale: Priority order: UX, mobile smoothness, maintainability, performance, visual quality, development simplicity; prefer premium iOS-quality solutions over quick hacks.

nodes.label: settings object as single source of truth
nodes.norm_label: settings object as single source of truth
nodes.rationale: Admin password, delivery cost, bonus percent and WhatsApp phone are read from settings, never hardcoded.
